paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
notes: Astrophysical bound from magnetic white dwarf polarization (SDSS J135141). Conservative fiducial 95% upper limit |g_agamma| < 5.4e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < ~3e-7 eV. Encoded as flat mass-independent line up to the stated mass validity range. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. Other MWD limits mentioned: Grw+70 8247 and PG1031+234 (~8.8e-12), SDSS J234605 (~2.1e-11), but SDSS J135141 gives the strongest quoted final limit. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 26)) | Vision: Traced the red 'conservative (fiducial)' curve from Figure 1, which is this paper's main constraint from SDSS J135141.
